Aerocool P500D High-Airflow Mid Tower Gaming Case (3 Pre-Installed ARGB Fans / Tempered Glass Side Window) + Aerocool LUX 650W 80 Plus Bronze Power Supply Bundle (1-Year Local Warranty)

Upgrade your gaming build with the high-value Aerocool P500D ARGB Mid Tower Case bundled with the reliable Aerocool LUX 650W 80 Plus Bronze Power Supply unit, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. The P500D chassis is designed with an ultra-fine mesh front panel and comes equipped with 3 factory pre-installed ARGB cooling fans, delivering optimum thermal airflow while presenting stunning lighting effects through its edge-to-edge tempered glass side window. Bundled together is the Aerocool LUX 650W PSU, featuring an 80 Plus Bronze efficiency rating to deliver clean, steady power output with up to 88% energy efficiency. With support for liquid cooling radiators up to 360mm, extended graphics cards, and clean cable routing channels, this complete chassis and power bundle offers everything required for a high-performance PC setup.
